summary: Iteration 72 - Integration Report Feature (Reporte Global de Integraciones Bancarias) - All backend (11/11) and frontend tests passed. Features verified: GET /api/banks/integrations/report returns flat list sorted by phase priority, report button on Banks page navigates to report, summary cards show counts per phase and toggle filter on click, dropdown filter works, table rows navigate to bank detail, status badges have correct semáforo colors, back button works.

issues: Console shows hydration error warning about <span> in <tbody> - this is a React warning from internal tooling, not affecting functionality

context_for_next_testing_agent: Integration Report feature fully working. Current data: 3 SQA integrations (not 5 as initially noted). Key test selectors: data-testid='integration-report-btn' (Banks page button), data-testid='integration-report-page' (page container), data-testid='filter-{negoc|desa|sqa|imple|preprod|completado}' (summary cards), data-testid='status-filter-select' (dropdown), data-testid='report-row-{integration_id}' (table rows), data-testid='back-to-banks-btn' (back button). Semáforo colors: Negoc=gray(slate), DESA=blue, SQA/Imple=amber, PreProd/Completado=green(emerald). Route /banks/integrations/report correctly placed before /banks/:bankId in App.js.
